title: Maputo–Katembe Bridge
visualBrief: Whole Maputo–Katembe suspension bridge and its intrinsic elevated approach viaducts/ramps: complete native named north/south road paths and connected elevated northern links; main suspended steel box deck, both concrete portal pylons, paired main cables/suspenders, approach concrete girders/piers, anchor blocks, barriers and four-lane road surface. All seven native elevated road records retained as plan provenance; paired carriageways resolve into the shared physical deck where coincident. Ground-level connecting highways, separate servicebridge37063620, port buildings, tollcampus, ferry terminals, natural shore/water and unrelated city structures excluded. Reconstruction uses published engineering dimensions and exact native road layout, with explicitly estimated small sections, color, supports, cable sag/hanger census and grades; no source photographs/figures used or photographic fidelity claimed.
